title: Interactive workspace chat manages automations through its managed MCP

requires.provider: Existing QA OpenAI authentication entry; never capture credential responses
requires.cleanup: Delete only the recorded disposable workspace, automation definitions, and runs

steps.expected: Start the disposable managed workspace with existing QA provider authentication and verify a main runtime on the new image revision.
Normal Agent chat discovers mapache-automations tools and its seeded guidance without workspace MCP configuration.

Ask chat to preview a schedule, create a disabled disposable automation, get and edit it using revisions, enable/disable it, inspect settings/history, and delete it. Verify tool results against the workspace API.
Ask chat to run a harmless fixture that only replies with a known marker, verify its final status, and remove the fixture after completion.
Stop and delete the recorded disposable workspace and verify its runner service is absent; preserve pre-existing QA credentials.
